cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Could you pinch these bouquet stems together? My wedding ribbon keeps sliding. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got them. You need wire underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Could you twist this bit round, just where your fingers are?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There. That sharp end will snag the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you tuck it in and wind the ribbon over it? One little bow would hide everything. I'll hold the scissors.
